title: Recover & Rebuild - Phase 1
author: Abbi Menear
desc:
Whether you're coming back to the gym after an injury, or you've just been out for a while, this is a good place to start. ********ONLY PARTICIPATE IN EXERCISE APPROVED BY YOUR DR********

This is meant to be a program to get you back into the routine of lifting, improving your range of motion and mobility, and getting to a place with limited joint pain while lifting.

If you start this routine and you're having pain even with the lowest level of weight and range of motion, spend some weeks just completing the mobility pieces of the first 10 weeks, possibly completing exercises for your problem joints every day.

This is stated throughout the exercises, but for each exercise, you should start at the lowest weight possible or the lowest weight you can complete the exercise without joint pain. Focus on range of motion, form, and consistency. Only increase weight when you can complete 3 sets to max reps without joint pain (or with limited joint pain if no pain isn't possible)

*************Once again, please do not participate in any activities without approval from your doctor. Especially if you're recovering from a serious injury*************
